meta.brief: Scandinavian: warm off-white + charcoal neutrals, one muted accent, generous whitespace, clean sans-serif, soft borders instead of heavy shadows.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white in light, warm charcoal (never pure black) in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, menus — one step lighter than the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells, code blocks, input backgrounds at rest.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Default hairline border for cards and dividers — the soft line that replaces a shadow. (Inputs rest on border-strong.)

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover / focus borders, and the resting border on interactive controls like buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. Charcoal on off-white, off-white on charcoal.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text — labels, helper text, metadata.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, the least emphasis. (Placeholders use ink-secondary for contrast.)

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one muted accent — primary buttons, links, active/selected state, focus rings. A dusty terracotta, never saturated.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state for accent-colored controls.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon color on top of a solid accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint for selected tags, subtle highlighted rows.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status — muted sage, kept small and semantic.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status — muted ochre.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error / destructive status — muted brick, never a hot red.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text — generous line-height for an airy, uncrowded page.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, form helper text, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, tag text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap — icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tag, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding, small control gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard padding inside cards and buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields, card padding on larger cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections within a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room above/below a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Generous top-level page margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, default controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, larger surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, the theme toggle track, avatar badges.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and state-color transitions on controls — quick enough to feel instant, slow enough to soften the change.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Default timing curve for those transitions. No bounce or overshoot.
